bio: Located just off the Town Hall Square is this luxurious bistro whose velvet armchairs, live electro music and energetic atmosphere attract a chic crowd – those who don’t mind sitting elbow-to-elbow at closely set tables that is. Top-quality ingredients are delivered in contemporary Japanese dishes with subtle global hints from Italian to Latin American. Sushi and tataki come with homemade condiments and are joined by the likes of black cod with yuzu miso and strip loin steak with chimichurri, while for dessert, there’s the choice of mochi or their signature tiramisu....
